'''Wind Strike''' is an [[Wind spells|air]]-based [[Strike spells|strike spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]] available starting at level 1 [[Magic]]. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

Wind Strike is the weakest wind spell in the game, as well as the first combat spell players gain access to. It is commonly used by players training Magic via [[splashing]], due to its low rune cost.

==Damage==
Wind Strike's base maximum hit starts at 2 and increases as the player unlocks additional strike spells, up to 8 at level 13 Magic.

As with all combat spells, Wind Strike's maximum hit is also increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As an air-based spell, Wind Strike's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to air]].

==Notable uses==
*On [[Tutorial Island]], the magic instructor [[Magic Instructor|Terrova]] tasks the player with casting Wind Strike on a [[chicken]].
*As a strike spell, Wind Strike is one of the only spells that can be used to damage [[Salarin the twisted]]. When used this way, its damage is scaled up to match that of [[Wind Bolt]].
